description: Validation rule configuration. Rules are data, not code: adding a check for a new entity means adding an entry here, not editing the engine. Each rule names a rule_type, which the engine resolves to a registered vectorised implementation.

rules.name: Exact duplicate master record
rules.message: Duplicate {key_column} value {value!r} appears {count} times.
rules.suggested_fix: Merge the duplicates using the survivorship rule (most complete, then most recent).

rules.name: Fuzzy duplicate master record
rules.message: Name {value!r} closely matches {match_value!r} ({score}% similar) on a different code.
rules.suggested_fix: Merge into the record with the more complete and more recently active profile.

rules.name: Missing mandatory field
rules.message: Mandatory field {column} is empty.
rules.suggested_fix: Obtain the missing value from the source system owner before migrating.

rules.name: Invalid GSTIN

params.description: 15 characters: 2 state digits, 10-character PAN, entity number, Z, checksum.

rules.message: GSTIN {value!r} does not match the required format.
rules.suggested_fix: Verify the GSTIN against the GST portal and correct it, or blank it and flag the vendor for review.

rules.name: Invalid PAN
rules.message: PAN {value!r} does not match the required format.
rules.suggested_fix: Correct the PAN from the vendor's tax registration certificate.

rules.name: Invalid email address

params.description: Local part, single at-sign, domain with a dot.

rules.message: Email {value!r} is not a valid address.
rules.suggested_fix: Correct the address or blank it; email is not a mandatory field.

rules.name: Invalid pincode
rules.message: Pincode {value!r} is not a valid 6-digit Indian postcode.
rules.suggested_fix: Look the pincode up from the city and state on the record.

rules.name: Invalid phone number

params.description: Optional +91 country code, then 10 digits starting 6 to 9.

rules.message: Phone {value!r} is not a valid Indian mobile number.
rules.suggested_fix: Normalise to +91XXXXXXXXXX format.

rules.name: Unknown unit of measure
rules.message: Unit of measure {value!r} does not exist in the UoM master.
rules.suggested_fix: Add the unit to the UoM master or map it to an existing unit.

rules.name: Inconsistent unit of measure spelling
rules.message: Unit {value!r} is a variant of the canonical unit {canonical!r}.
rules.suggested_fix: Normalise to the canonical unit {canonical}.

rules.name: Obsolete record with no recent activity
rules.message: No activity since {value} ({years} years). Archive rather than migrate.
rules.suggested_fix: Move to the archive set so the record is preserved but not loaded into the new ERP.

rules.name: Inconsistent whitespace or casing
rules.message: Field {column} has stray whitespace or inconsistent casing ({issue}).
rules.suggested_fix: Trim whitespace, collapse repeated spaces and apply consistent title case.

rules.name: Non-ISO date format
rules.message: Date field {column} uses a non-ISO format ({value!r}).
rules.suggested_fix: Normalise to ISO 8601 (YYYY-MM-DD).

rules.name: Invoice references a missing customer
rules.message: Customer {value!r} does not exist in the customer master.
rules.suggested_fix: Create the missing customer from the invoice header, or quarantine the invoice.

rules.name: Purchase order references a missing supplier
rules.message: Supplier {value!r} does not exist in the supplier master.
rules.suggested_fix: Create the missing supplier, or quarantine the purchase order.

rules.name: Item references a missing category
rules.message: Category {value!r} does not exist in the category master.
rules.suggested_fix: Assign the item to an existing category, or create the missing category.

rules.name: Ledger line references a missing account
rules.message: Account {value!r} does not exist in the chart of accounts.
rules.suggested_fix: Map the account to the new chart of accounts, or quarantine the ledger line.

rules.name: Trial balance does not balance
rules.message: Period {fiscal_year}-{period} is out of balance by {difference} (debits {debit_total}, credits {credit_total}).
rules.suggested_fix: Investigate the unbalanced period with the finance controller before loading.

rules.name: Retired tax code in use
rules.message: Tax code {value!r} is retired and must not be used on migrated documents.
rules.suggested_fix: Map to the current equivalent tax code, or reclassify as exempt.

rules.name: Currency mismatch with master record
rules.message: Invoice currency {value!r} differs from the customer currency {parent_value!r}.
rules.suggested_fix: Confirm the invoicing currency, then either convert or correct the customer record.

rules.name: Negative stock on hand
rules.message: Quantity on hand is negative ({value}).
rules.suggested_fix: Recount the physical stock and correct the opening balance.

rules.name: Impossible date
rules.message: {reason} ({column} = {value}).
rules.suggested_fix: Correct the date against the source document.

rules.name: Duplicate invoice number
rules.message: Invoice number {value!r} appears {count} times.
rules.suggested_fix: Keep the earliest complete invoice and reject the rest as duplicates.

rules.name: Salary outlier
rules.message: Gross salary {value} is {ratio}x the {group} median ({median}).
rules.suggested_fix: Verify the salary with HR; it may be a data entry error.

rules.name: Negative invoice total
rules.message: Invoice total is negative ({value}) without a credit note flag.
rules.suggested_fix: Mark as a credit note, or correct the amount.

rules.name: Invoice total does not equal subtotal plus tax
rules.message: Total {value} does not equal subtotal plus tax ({expected}).
rules.suggested_fix: Recalculate the invoice total from its components.

rules.name: Mixed date formats in one column
rules.message: {column} contains {format_count} different date formats.
rules.suggested_fix: Normalise every value in the column to ISO 8601.
